Trial cross-check

Top-10 NOVEL graph predictions (PrimeKG indications removed) for held-out test diseases vs 10 random approved drugs; a registered trial (any phase/status) matching the condition and intervention counts as a hit. Model: 27.6% (20.9%–34.4%); random approved drugs: 7.8% (5.2%–11.3%).
